title: COMO HAD 57% OF THE BALL AND STILL LOST TO INTER
description:
Six wins in a row for Lazio, two goals for Inter, one point between them. Suddenly the table is interesting.

Como had the ball. Inter had the goals. Fifty-seven percent possession and one shot on target, and Inter won two-nil at San Siro. Pio Esposito scored in the twelfth minute. Marcus Thuram doubled it in the nineteenth. Possession is not a scoreboard.

Meanwhile, Lazio's six-game winning run ended in a one-one draw at Napoli. That leaves Inter one point behind.
